integrity: Analytical proof with independent exact small-order enumeration and exact rational moment identities; no external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves an annealed Gaussian limit only for balanced shores, monochrome initial state, p -> 0, np^2/log^2(1/p) -> infinity. Does not settle all np -> infinity regimes, unbalanced classes, fixed p, or quenched fluctuations. Historical priority remains provisional pending independent review.
title: A Gaussian sparse-edge window for local maxima in balanced random bipartite graphs
